title: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 are returning to Claude Platform, with usage credit transition after July 7th
summary: Anthropic is redeploying Fable 5 globally across its platforms, including Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork. While Pro, Max, Team, and some Enterprise users will have Fable 5 included for up to 50% of weekly usage limits until July 7th, access will transition to usage credits thereafter.
why_included: The redeployment of advanced models like Fable 5 and Mythos 5 is a significant development for users.

title: Anthropic's pricing page shows no significant changes
summary: A review of Anthropic's pricing page shows no new or modified pricing information. The content remains identical to the previous version observed.
why_included: While no change was detected, monitoring pricing pages is crucial for identifying potential pricing shifts.

title: Google Gemini Pricing page shows no changes in core structure, but translation detected
summary: The Google Gemini Pricing page has been analyzed, and while the core structure appears unchanged, the content has been translated into Arabic. No new pricing or product announcements were detected.
why_included: Monitoring pricing pages is important for detecting changes, even if only localization is observed.
